description: Source code for loading and managing message catalogs in the GNU gettext system, including file handling, memory mapping, charset conversion, and catalog parsing.

methods.name: _nl_init_domain_conv
methods.description: Initializes charset conversion for a loaded message catalog based on its charset info.

methods.name: _nl_free_domain_conv
methods.description: Frees resources associated with charset conversion for a domain.

methods.name: _nl_load_domain
methods.description: Loads a message catalog file, memory maps or reads it, and parses its header and tables.

methods.name: _nl_unload_domain
methods.description: Unloads a loaded message catalog, freeing resources.
